name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support scheme to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for agricultural inputs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each directly into bank accounts.
eligibility: Small and marginal landholder farmer families with cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares.
Valid Aadhaar and bank account linked with NPCI.
application_process: Click on Farmers Corner and select New Farmer Registration
Submit Aadhaar number and land details for verification

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: National public health insurance fund that aims to provide free access to healthcare for low income earners in the country.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility: Families identified under the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 database as deprived rural households and occupational categories of urban workers.
application_process: Check eligibility on mera.pmjay.gov.in or visit any empaneled hospital
Present identity proof to the Ayushman Mitra for instant verification

name: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
description: Educational scheme in Rajasthan providing free residential schooling in reputed private English medium schools for students from Special Backward Classes.
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free quality education from Class 6 to 12 in selected prestigious residential schools, including lodging, boarding, uniforms, and textbooks.
eligibility: Resident of Rajasthan belonging to designated Special Backward Classes (Banjara, Gadia Luhar, Gujjar, Raika, Gadaria).
Family annual income not exceeding Rs. 2.5 Lakhs.
application_process: Apply through Rajasthan SSO portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) using SJMS portal application form
Appear for the state entrance examination conducted by the Department

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Flagship social welfare programme to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to all houseless households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses.
benefits: Financial assistance of Rs. 1,20,000 in plains and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult areas for pucca house construction.
Additional 90/95 person days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS.
eligibility: Houseless families or households living in zero, one or two-room houses with kutcha wall and roof as per SECC 2011 data.
application_process: Gram Sabha verifies the eligible beneficiary list derived from Awaas+ survey
Registration completed through Gram Panchayat office

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
description: Scholarship assistance for students belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes studying post-matriculation courses.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable tuition and examination fees along with monthly maintenance allowances.
eligibility: Bonafide resident of Rajasthan studying in recognized higher education institutions.
Annual family income ceiling of Rs. 2,50,000 for SC/ST and Rs. 1,50,000 for OBC.
documents: Fee receipt of current academic year
application_process: Log in to Rajasthan Single Sign On (SSO) portal
Access Scholarship (SJMS) application and fill academic details
Upload verified fee receipts and submit to institution nodal officer

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana
description: Universal health insurance scheme for all families residing in Rajasthan covering tertiary and secondary care hospitalization costs.
ministry: Department of Medical, Health and Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless medical treatment cover up to Rs. 25,00,000 per family per year across empaneled government and private hospitals.
eligibility: All resident families of Rajasthan possessing a valid Jan Aadhaar card.
Free coverage for NFSA, SECC, small farmers, and contractual workers; nominal premium for others.
application_process: Register at nearest E-Mitra kiosk or online through the Chiranjeevi portal using Jan Aadhaar ID
Show Jan Aadhaar card at hospital Chiranjeevi helpdesk during admission
